## Dialect type

The SQL dialects the schema builder knows how to compile for.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Dialect = 'postgres' | 'mysql' | 'sqlite';
```

## Remarks

Everything above the driver layer (migrations, seeders, the schema builder) is written once and compiled per dialect, so application code never needs to branch on which database is configured.
